payload.summary: The incident involves a brute-force SSH attack on the account jdoe on the host victim-web-01 from the source IP 198.51.100.77. The attack included 13 failed login attempts followed by a successful login, which is highly suspicious given that the source IP had no prior successful logins in the 30 days before the incident. This activity aligns with a brute-force attack pattern.

attack_chain.description: The attacker used brute-force techniques to guess the password for the account jdoe on the host victim-web-01 from the source IP 198.51.100.77.

risk_factors: Unusual source IP with no prior successful logins

proposed_actions.justification: The account jdoe was successfully logged into after multiple failed attempts from an unusual source IP, indicating a potential compromise.
